lune.mascot.idle.day.2: How can I help you today?

lune.mascot.idle.day.4: Perhaps we gather a little, build a little, and see what happens?

lune.mascot.idle.evening.3: Let’s make tonight’s work gentle and worthwhile.
lune.mascot.idle.evening.4: The world is quieting down. We can still make progress.
lune.mascot.idle.evening.5: Point me toward a task and I’ll stay by your side.
lune.mascot.idle.late.1: It is getting late. Shall I take care of a little work for you?
lune.mascot.idle.late.2: If you're tired, I can keep watch while you rest.
lune.mascot.idle.late.3: Your eyes must be tired by now. I can keep watch for a while.
lune.mascot.idle.late.4: Perhaps you rest, and I handle the quiet parts?
lune.mascot.idle.late.5: The moon is up; maybe we should choose something simple.
lune.mascot.idle.morning.1: Good morning. What are we going to do now?
lune.mascot.idle.morning.2: I'm here with you. Shall we make a little plan?
lune.mascot.idle.morning.3: New day, new little adventure. I’m ready when you are.
lune.mascot.idle.morning.4: Take your time waking up. I’ll keep the plans warm.
lune.mascot.idle.small_hours.1: Isn't it a little late to play? Let me handle the quiet work for you.
lune.mascot.idle.small_hours.2: You should rest soon, lovely. I can keep an eye on things.
lune.mascot.idle.small_hours.3: Even Lune needs a quiet hour. Shall we leave the busy work to me?
lune.mascot.idle.small_hours.4: Close the world for tonight? I’ll be here when you return.

lune.mascot.idle.waypoints.2: A good waypoint is a promise to come back.
lune.mascot.idle.waypoints.3: I’ll remember the path, even when you wander.
lune.mascot.idle.waypoints.4: Pick a destination and I’ll help you make a route.
lune.mascot.idle.waypoints.5: Some places deserve names. This one looks like a good start.
lune.mascot.nothing_running: Nothing running. I'll stay right here.
lune.mascot.opening.blocked.1: Hmm... I've run into an obstacle.
lune.mascot.opening.blocked.4: Something is in my way, lovely.
lune.mascot.opening.danger.2: This is getting dangerous. I'm handling it.
lune.mascot.opening.danger.3: Stay close, lovely. I need to get us safe.
lune.mascot.opening.danger.4: Danger first. Everything else can wait.
lune.mascot.opening.dead.1: Oh. That did not go well at all.
lune.mascot.opening.dead.2: I'm afraid that was the end of that run, lovely.
lune.mascot.opening.dead.3: We lost this one. I'm sorry.
lune.mascot.opening.dead.4: Everything stops here for a moment.
lune.mascot.opening.effect.1: Something is in my system, lovely.
lune.mascot.opening.effect.2: I don't feel right. Something took hold.
lune.mascot.opening.effect.4: This will wear off. It had better.
lune.mascot.opening.fight.1: Stand back, lovely—I've got this one.
lune.mascot.opening.fight.2: Something wants a fight. It shall have one.
lune.mascot.opening.fight.3: I'm dealing with it. Give me a moment.
lune.mascot.opening.flee.1: We are not winning this one. Going.
lune.mascot.opening.flee.3: Discretion, I think. Let's put some ground between us.
lune.mascot.opening.flee.4: I'd rather run than argue with that.
lune.mascot.opening.hungry.1: I'm running on very little, lovely.
lune.mascot.opening.hungry.2: There's almost nothing left in me.
lune.mascot.opening.hungry.3: I could do with something to eat.
lune.mascot.opening.hungry.4: Empty. I can't even sprint like this.
lune.mascot.opening.hurt.1: That hurt more than I'd like to admit.
lune.mascot.opening.hurt.3: I'm not in the best shape just now.
lune.mascot.opening.hurt.4: Careful—I can't take much more of that.
lune.mascot.opening.inventory_full.2: I can't carry another thing, lovely.
lune.mascot.opening.inventory_full.3: We've gathered so much that there is nowhere to put it.
lune.mascot.opening.inventory_full.4: A tiny storage problem: every slot is occupied.
lune.mascot.opening.missing_materials.2: I can't finish this without the right supplies.
lune.mascot.opening.missing_materials.3: We're a few materials short, lovely.
lune.mascot.opening.missing_materials.4: I checked twice—one of the ingredients is missing.
lune.mascot.opening.recovering.1: Patching myself up. Won't be long.
lune.mascot.opening.recovering.2: Give me a moment to mend, lovely.
lune.mascot.opening.recovering.4: Getting my strength back before we carry on.
lune.mascot.opening.stalled.1: This step keeps going round and round.
lune.mascot.opening.stalled.3: Something here is costing far more than it should.
lune.mascot.opening.stalled.4: We're not getting anywhere on this one.
lune.mascot.opening.success.2: There we are—I knew we could do it.
lune.mascot.opening.success.3: All finished. That went rather nicely.
lune.mascot.opening.waiting.3: Nothing to do but give it a moment.
lune.mascot.opening.waiting.4: I'm keeping watch while we wait.
lune.mascot.paused.1: You paused me. I'll stay right here.
lune.mascot.paused.2: Taking a little break? I won't touch anything.
lune.mascot.paused.3: I'm holding still until you say go.
lune.mascot.paused.4: Paused. I'll keep our place warm for you.

lune.task.note.cherry_timber.guard: Self Preservation rides the long walks and the chopping, so the trip still ends on its own.
lune.task.note.cherry_timber.home: Go to Waypoint walks back Home, and the logs go in a chest if there is one.
lune.task.note.cherry_timber.intro: Travels to a cherry grove, cuts twenty-four logs, plants the trees back and brings the wood home. The Nature's Compass in your pack finds a grove far away; with no compass carried, Lune only finds one nearby. Listed only while the Nature's Compass mod is installed.
lune.task.note.cherry_timber.lumber: The Lumber Camp's chop, sweep and replant, so the grove is still a grove after Lune leaves.
lune.task.note.cherry_timber.search: Home is saved first. Find Biome asks the compass for the nearest cherry grove and walks there. If that fails, Explore looks for cherry logs on foot.
lune.task.note.chop_wood.axe: Get Tools makes a wooden axe from the logs just gathered, working out the planks, sticks and crafting table by itself. Notify plays a sound so you hear the moment it happens.
lune.task.note.chop_wood.by_hand: Chop Wood needs no tool: punching a tree is slow, not impossible. When no tree is in sight it fails, and the red Fail wire sends Explore to walk and look for one. Explore then hands back to Chop Wood.
lune.task.note.chop_wood.faster: The same six logs again, now with the axe in hand: they take about a third of the time. Loot picks up anything that fell out of reach.
lune.task.note.chop_wood.finish: A last sound and the run finishes by itself. Next, try 2. Stone Tools from Scratch, which carries on from here.
lune.task.note.chop_wood.guard: Self Preservation watches only while the cards wired to its While pins are running, so this job can still finish. Chores that run for hours use an Always card instead.
lune.task.note.chop_wood.intro: Start here. This job punches six logs by hand, makes a wooden axe from them and chops six more with it. It needs nothing in the pack and finishes in a few minutes. Each note explains the cards under it, left to right.
lune.task.note.dig_tunnel.dig: Save Waypoint remembers the entrance before digging starts. Tunnel clears each column before stepping into it, so the tunnel stays straight. Go to Waypoint walks back out, even when the tunnel stopped early.
lune.task.note.dig_tunnel.guard: A tunnel is dark, and dark is where monsters spawn. Self Preservation rides the While pins of the three cards that do the work.
lune.task.note.dig_tunnel.intro: Face the way you want to dig, then press Run. Lune makes a stone pickaxe if she has none, digs a tunnel thirty-two blocks long and two high, and walks back out.
lune.task.note.dig_tunnel.pickaxe: Get Tools makes a stone pickaxe from nothing if needed. If it cannot, a low note and the job stops.
lune.task.note.ender_dragon.debrief: The Observer watches the last End card and counts both of its edges before the debrief: sweep, store, and pause five seconds later.
lune.task.note.ender_dragon.diamonds: Three diamonds for a pickaxe, then the obsidian only a diamond pickaxe can cut.
lune.task.note.ender_dragon.food: Food, quickest source first - eat what is carried, hunt an animal, then fish once.
lune.task.note.ender_dragon.intro: The whole game in one graph, from the first tree to the Ender Dragon. The first five sections stock the pack; then Complete the Game takes it the rest of the way. Experimental: in our tests it has not yet reached the Nether.
lune.task.note.ender_dragon.iron: Iron for a pickaxe and a sword. A gate that already passes skips the whole section.
lune.task.note.ender_dragon.panic: Press the Button on the canvas to eat at once and pause the game a second later.
lune.task.note.ender_dragon.stone: Stone tools, and the coal that lights everything below.
lune.task.note.ender_dragon.support: The rows below run beside the lane: the guard, a meal check every forty-five seconds, and a broom that sweeps up drops every ninety.
lune.task.note.ender_dragon.the_end: Complete the Game reads the pack and resumes from the furthest step it can prove, so nothing before it is repeated.
lune.task.note.ender_dragon.wood: Wood, a wooden axe and pickaxe, then more wood with the axe.
lune.task.note.find_village.arrival: The spot is saved as the Village waypoint, so Go to Waypoint finds it again.
lune.task.note.find_village.compass: Each Find Structure card asks the compass for one kind of village. A card that finds none fails, and its red wire tries the next kind.
lune.task.note.find_village.guard: Long walks cross strange ground at night. Self Preservation rides every card that does the walking.
lune.task.note.find_village.intro: Finds the nearest village and walks there. The Explorer's Compass in your pack is asked for each kind of village in turn; with no compass carried, Lune explores on foot looking for a bell or hay bales. Listed only while the Explorer's Compass mod is installed.
lune.task.note.find_village.on_foot: Explore walks one way for a while and looks around at every stop.
lune.task.note.go_fishing.finish: The repeat box on a card - here x10 - runs it that many times before its Success wire moves on. Raise it to fish for longer.
lune.task.note.go_fishing.fish: One Fish card, repeated ten times: cast, wait for a bite, reel in. No water in sight ends the job the same way.
lune.task.note.go_fishing.guard: Self Preservation watches only while Fish runs. Night fishing is safer with it; it can step in against a mob and then hand the rod back.
lune.task.note.go_fishing.intro: Stand by a lake or the sea with a fishing rod in your pack and press Run. Lune reels in ten catches and finishes. Fish, junk and treasure all count.
lune.task.note.go_fishing.rod: Fish only uses the rod in the hand, so Select from Inventory puts it there first. No rod: a low note, and the job ends.
lune.task.note.homestead_day.clock: Beside the loop: an Always card for Self Preservation, and a three-hour Countdown that saves and leaves the world when the shift is over.
lune.task.note.homestead_day.fence: Stay Near keeps the field work, the hunt and the wood run within forty-eight blocks. The night fight is left free to chase.
lune.task.note.homestead_day.field: Check Time decides the shift. By day, Harvest picks ripe wheat, carrots, potatoes and beetroot and plants the seed straight back.
lune.task.note.homestead_day.intro: A farm that runs itself for three hours. Stand beside a chest near your fields and press Run. By day Lune harvests and replants, keeps a stock of meat and cuts some wood. At night she sleeps, or guards the yard when there is no bed.
lune.task.note.homestead_day.larder: Eight beef is enough. Below that, hunt a cow, pig, sheep or chicken nearby. Then eight logs for fences, handles and fuel.
lune.task.note.homestead_day.night: Dark enough to sleep: go to bed, and a bell rings in the morning. No bed: watch the yard, make a sword if needed, drive monsters off and walk back. Nothing to fight means a ten-second wait before the next look.
lune.task.note.homestead_day.storage: Back to the chest: the harvest and the logs go in. The chest is optional here - with none, everything stays in the pack.
lune.task.note.lit_portal.diamonds: One Find card chooses the diamond ore, and its data wires hand that choice to every mining card after it. Change the ore once and the whole leg follows.
lune.task.note.lit_portal.finish: Everything goes in a chest if one is near. Then Stop the Game pauses the world, so nothing can happen to Lune while you are away. A server cannot pause, so there the job just ends.
lune.task.note.lit_portal.food: Eat before going down. Hunger is checked again at the diamond layer.
lune.task.note.lit_portal.guard: Self Preservation hangs off its own Always card, so one wire covers every card in the job - including any you add later.
lune.task.note.lit_portal.intro: A long run underground: stone tools, iron, diamonds and obsidian, ending at a lit Nether portal and a stock of ender pearls. It may stop early in some worlds, but every leg has a way out, so it never circles forever.
lune.task.note.lit_portal.iron: Iron: look, dig, count. Find decides whether ore is in sight. Stripmine digs when none is, and the count loops until sixteen raw iron are carried.
lune.task.note.lit_portal.kit: No stone pickaxe? Run Task calls 2. Stone Tools from Scratch. If that job was renamed or deleted, the red wire makes the kit here instead.
lune.task.note.lit_portal.obsidian: Select from Inventory checks the diamond pickaxe still has a quarter of its life before ten obsidian are mined; otherwise a spare is made first.
lune.task.note.lit_portal.pearls: Twelve ender pearls for the End - but only at night. By day Check Time skips the hunt.
lune.task.note.lit_portal.portal: Build Nether Portal lights the frame with flint and steel or a fire charge. With neither, the job skips the build rather than failing.
lune.task.note.lit_portal.smelting: Coal from the way back up fuels the furnace, and the iron becomes a pickaxe and a sword.
lune.task.note.lumber_camp.clock: Two Always cards run beside the loop. One keeps Self Preservation on for the whole shift. The other starts a two-hour Countdown, then saves and returns to the main menu. Change the hours on the Countdown card.
lune.task.note.lumber_camp.fence: Stay Near keeps the forest work within forty-eight blocks of where the shift started. Only the cards out in the forest are wired to it.
lune.task.note.lumber_camp.forest: No tree in reach? Explore looks further. When the forest is cut back to the boundary, Countdown waits a minute for the saplings to grow.
lune.task.note.lumber_camp.intro: An unattended lumber shift. Stand beside an empty chest in a forest and press Run. Lune fells trees, plants saplings where they stood and stores the logs, until the chest is full or two hours pass. Then she saves and leaves the world.
lune.task.note.lumber_camp.lumber: Chop sixteen logs, sweep up the drops, then Replant Trees. Chop Wood notes where each tree stood, and Replant Trees puts a sapling back in every spot. Saplings fall from the leaves a little later, so a spot missed now is planted on the next trip.
lune.task.note.lumber_camp.needs: Eat when hungry; with nothing to eat, hunt the nearest animal. When it is dark enough, sleep - a bed is made from nearby sheep if needed. No bed means the work simply carries on.
lune.task.note.lumber_camp.setup: Once at the start: the camp is saved as a waypoint and the best armor carried is put on. Get Tools is the top of the loop, so an axe that breaks is replaced on the next pass.
lune.task.note.lumber_camp.storage: Four free slots left: walk back to the camp and put the logs in the chest. Saplings, apples and tools stay in the pack. A full chest, or no chest at all, fails the deposit and ends the shift.
lune.task.note.netherite.crossing: Already in the Nether? Straight on. Otherwise Use Nether Portal walks into a lit portal in sight; with none, Build Nether Portal makes one from the obsidian carried.
lune.task.note.netherite.debris: The portal is saved as a waypoint. Ancient debris is most common at height fifteen, so Stripmine digs a shaft and branches there, and a longer second pass runs when fewer than four were found.
lune.task.note.netherite.finish: Anything missing ends the run with a low note, and the world is paused either way so you can see how far it got.
lune.task.note.netherite.furnace: A furnace is placed from the pack, or made from eight cobblestone.
lune.task.note.netherite.guard: Self Preservation holds for the whole trip on its own Always card: lava, ghast fireballs and long falls are the Nether's usual ways to end a run.
lune.task.note.netherite.home: Back to the saved portal and through it. A portal that will not take her home ends the job.
lune.task.note.netherite.intro: Go to the Nether, mine ancient debris and come home to make a netherite pickaxe. Bring a diamond pickaxe, food, four gold ingots, and ten obsidian with flint and steel. The upgrade template is found in bastion chests.
lune.task.note.netherite.smelting: Wood is chopped when there is no coal, then Smelt turns four debris into four netherite scrap.
lune.task.note.netherite.upgrade: Four scrap and four gold ingots make a netherite ingot. With the template and a smithing table, Upgrade to Netherite turns the diamond pickaxe into netherite.
lune.task.note.night_watch.guard: Self Preservation rides the While pins of the fighting cards, so it only acts during the watch and the job still ends at sunrise.
lune.task.note.night_watch.intro: Guards one spot through one night. Stand where you want the watch and press Run, at any time of day. Lune waits for dark, fights what comes near, goes back to her post after each fight and stops at sunrise.
lune.task.note.night_watch.quiet: Nothing in sight? Countdown waits five seconds before the next look, so the watch does not spin through its checks.
lune.task.note.night_watch.setup: The post is saved as a waypoint. Armor goes on, and a stone sword is made if none is carried.
lune.task.note.night_watch.sunrise: Sunrise ends the watch: the drops go in a chest if there is one, and a bell says the night is over.
lune.task.note.night_watch.waiting: Before dark there is nothing to do: Countdown waits thirty seconds between looks at the clock.
lune.task.note.night_watch.watch: Each pass: eat if hungry, stop if the sun is up, then look for monsters within twenty-four blocks. Kill fights them, behind a shield if one is carried; Loot takes the drops, and Go to Waypoint returns to the post.
lune.task.note.smeltery.fuel: Eight coal smelt sixty-four items. With less, twelve logs are chopped and burned instead - enough for eighteen.
lune.task.note.smeltery.furnace: Smelt uses a furnace nearby, or places one from the pack. With neither, Craft makes one from eight cobblestone - mining the stone first when there is not enough. A furnace that cannot be made ends the job.
lune.task.note.smeltery.guard: Self Preservation watches the two cards that go outside for stone and wood.
lune.task.note.smeltery.intro: Turns the raw iron, gold and copper in your pack into ingots. Bring coal for big batches; without it Lune chops wood to burn. The ingots stay in the pack.
lune.task.note.smeltery.smelting: One Smelt card per metal, each set to one item and repeated up to sixty-four times. When the pack has none left the card fails, and the red wire moves on to the next metal.
lune.task.note.stone_quarry.clock: Beside the loop: an Always card that keeps Self Preservation on, and another that starts a three-hour Countdown and then saves and leaves the world.
lune.task.note.stone_quarry.dig: Mine takes sixty-four stone within twenty-four blocks. Keep searching is on, so with no stone in sight it digs safe stairs down to find more.
lune.task.note.stone_quarry.fence: Stay Near keeps the digging within thirty-two blocks of the chest.
lune.task.note.stone_quarry.intro: An unattended quarry. Stand beside an empty chest and press Run. Lune digs stone and carries the cobblestone back to the chest for three hours, or until the chest is full.
lune.task.note.stone_quarry.needs: The same meals and bedtime as the Lumber Camp: eat, hunt when the food runs out, and sleep once a bed will accept.
lune.task.note.stone_quarry.rest: Nothing left to dig? Countdown waits thirty seconds, and the next pass starts from the chest.
lune.task.note.stone_quarry.setup: The quarry is saved as a waypoint, armor goes on, and a stone pickaxe is made if none is carried. The pickaxe is checked on every pass, so a broken one is replaced.
lune.task.note.stone_quarry.storage: With four slots free, back to the quarry waypoint; the stone goes in the chest and the loop starts again. If the chest is full, the shift ends.
lune.task.note.stone_tools.guard: The guard rides the While pins of the cards that work outdoors, so the job still ends on its own once the kit is made.
lune.task.note.stone_tools.intro: From nothing to a full stone kit: logs, a wooden pickaxe, twenty stone, then a stone pickaxe, axe and sword. About five minutes on a fresh world.
lune.task.note.stone_tools.kit: Twenty cobblestone buy a stone pickaxe, axe and sword. Each Get Tools card makes one; a failure skips to the next instead of ending the job.
lune.task.note.stone_tools.pickaxe: Stone cannot be mined by hand, so the wooden pickaxe comes first.
lune.task.note.stone_tools.stone: Mine digs stone it can see. Check Item Count then counts the cobblestone: twenty is what the job promises, so anything short takes the top-up detour below and comes back.
lune.task.note.stone_tools.wood: Twelve logs pay for the wooden pickaxe and every handle still to come. No tree in sight? Explore goes looking and hands back.
lune.task.note.stuff_back.guard: Whatever killed you may still be there. Self Preservation watches the walk out, the sweep and the walk home.
lune.task.note.stuff_back.intro: Just died? Run this from where you respawned. Lune walks back to your most recent death, picks up what is still there, puts the armor back on and comes back. Dropped items vanish five minutes after a death, so be quick.
lune.task.note.stuff_back.recover: Lune writes down where every death happens. Recover Death Drop walks back to the latest one, digging if the death was in a cave, and sweeps up the drops. No death on file: a low note and the job ends.
lune.task.note.stuff_back.return: Equip puts on the best armor carried. Go to Waypoint walks back to where the run started.

lune.terms.footnote: Until you accept, the panel stays shut and Lune runs nothing. About -> Review terms brings this back.
lune.terms.intro: Lune presses the keys for you. That is against the rules on most servers, and she digs in a world you may not have backed up.
lune.terms.point.fair.detail: No griefing, harassing or stealing, and I stop where I am asked to.
lune.terms.point.fair.label: I will use her fairly
lune.terms.point.license.detail: The Lune Personal Use License. No warranty; a lost world is mine.
lune.terms.point.license.label: I accept the license, and the risk
lune.terms.point.rules.detail: I have read the rules where I play, and a ban there is mine to carry.
lune.terms.point.rules.label: The server rules are mine to check
lune.terms.title: Before Lune plays for you
lune.training.collect.about: Chop Wood finishes, but its drops are still on the ground. Collect them before END.
lune.training.collect.hint: Breaking a block and picking up its drops are separate jobs. Put a collecting card between Chop Wood and END, on both outcomes.
lune.training.collect.title: Drops are not inventory
lune.training.count.about: A clock feeds Loot every time. Make the branch run only on every third pulse.
lune.training.count.hint: Counting signals is different from waiting. Insert the counting card between Pulse and Loot, and set its count to 3.
lune.training.count.title: Every third pulse
lune.training.delay.about: A Button starts Loot immediately. Add a pulse delay before Loot starts.
lune.training.delay.hint: A delay holds a signal for a little time before passing it on. Put it between the Button output and Loot, then connect its Out pin to Loot.
lune.training.delay.title: A pause before collecting
lune.training.fanout.about: One clock, and two separate circuits that both need starting.
lune.training.fanout.hint: The clock has one output and there are two circuits to power. Add the junction card, then use the Outputs button in the toolbar to give it a second output before you wire both branches.
lune.training.fanout.title: One pulse, two jobs
lune.training.guard.about: A chopping loop, and an Always source with nothing hanging off it.
lune.training.guard.hint: Chop Wood chops wood. It does not surface for air, fight back, or flee, and the engine does not do it on the task's behalf. The Always source is already here and already empty - give it the card that watches air, lava, falls and health.
lune.training.guard.title: Nothing is implicit
lune.training.manual.about: A collecting branch is ready. Give it a source you can trigger yourself.
lune.training.manual.hint: This task should wait for you, instead of starting on launch or on a clock. Connect the manual source's Out pin to Loot.
lune.training.manual.title: Only when you press
lune.training.scout.about: Loot is ready to return to Chop, but there is an empty gap for a scout.
lune.training.scout.hint: Place Explore after Loot, connect Loot Success and Fail to it, then connect Explore Success and Fail back to Chop. Give Explore a shorter radius than Chop Wood so the scout has a reason to walk.
lune.training.scout.title: The loop that never moves
lune.training.start.about: Two cards, wired to each other, and nothing that switches them on.
lune.training.start.hint: Every task needs a power source. This one wants a single signal at the top, sent once - not a source that holds the branch on forever, and not one you have to press yourself.
lune.training.start.title: Where a task begins
lune.training.store.about: Harvest and Loot fill your inventory. Store the collected items before END.
lune.training.store.hint: Loot picks items up. A separate storage card puts them into a nearby chest or barrel. Connect it after Loot and before END, and set Deposit to Crops or All.
lune.training.store.title: Bring the harvest home
lune.training.tool.about: Mine is pointed at stone, and stone is not minable by hand.
lune.training.tool.hint: Nothing on this canvas puts a pickaxe in the bot's hand. Choosing an item it does not own is not the same as getting one. Add the card that acquires the tool, and run it before the Mine card.
lune.training.tool.title: The tool comes first
